_note: US seller fees. Every number here was read from the source listed on the date in checked. Re-check before launch and whenever the monitor flags a change.

ebay.name: eBay
ebay.source_note: eBay Seller Center, seller fees page
ebay.summary: 13.6% of the total sale amount (item + shipping + sales tax) up to $7,500, plus $0.30 per order ($0.40 if the order is over $10).

bags.label: Women's bags
bags.note: One rate on the whole sale: 15% if the total is $2,000 or less, 9% if it is over $2,000.

poshmark.name: Poshmark
poshmark.summary: A flat $2.95 on sales under $15, and 20% of the sale price on sales of $15 or more. Buyers pay the shipping label.

mercari.name: Mercari
mercari.source_note: Mercari Help Center, fee structure (effective Jan 6, 2025)
mercari.summary: A flat 10% of the item price plus any shipping the buyer pays. No separate payment processing fee. Instant Pay withdrawals cost $3.

depop.name: Depop
depop.source_note: Depop Help Centre, seller fees and charges
depop.summary: No selling fee in the US. Payment processing is 3.3% + $0.45 on the full transaction (item + shipping + tax). Boosted listings add a boost fee if the item sells through the boost.
depop.boost_note: Depop's Boosted Listings Policy (effective March 23, 2026) sets the boost fee at 12% of the item price. It isn't charged on Depop shipping labels or on tax.

etsy.name: Etsy
etsy.source_note: Etsy Fees & Payments Policy (updated Oct 5, 2026) and Etsy Payments Policy (updated Jul 31, 2026)
etsy.summary: $0.20 listing fee, 6.5% transaction fee on item + shipping, and 3% + $0.25 payment processing on the order total including tax. Offsite Ads add 15% (12% for shops over $10k a year), capped at $100 per order.

whatnot.name: Whatnot
whatnot.source_note: Whatnot Help Center, seller fees: tiered commission effective September 21, 2026
whatnot.summary: Whatnot commission varies by seller tier, category and market. The initial US baseline is up to 8% of the item price (4% for coins); the seller's exact rate is in Seller Hub. Processing is typically 2.9% + $0.30 on the buyer's order total. Enter your own rate for an accurate estimate.

collectibles.label: Comics, TCG, sports singles, toys and hobbies

whatnot.rate_note: Since September 21, 2026, seller tiers update by sales volume over four-week periods. The 8% general / 4% coins values are starting-tier examples, not guaranteed rates. Use the commission rate shown in your Whatnot Seller Hub; limited-time promotions and seller-specific rates are excluded.

paypal.name: PayPal
paypal.summary: Goods and services payments sent to you cost 2.99%. PayPal Checkout on a website costs 3.49% + $0.49. International payments add 1.5%.

checkout.label: PayPal Checkout or Venmo on a website
